title: Wigan says only 2 out of 16 libraries safe: Redbridge announce 5 closures.
author: Ian Anstice / The Library Campaign

editorial.text: 263 libraries plus 17 mobiles currently under threat or recently closed. Wigan has put out a public consultation that says only 2 of its 17 libraries are safe from closure. It is unlikely Wigan will close all of these but it is possible so the figure stands as 15 out of 17 under threat. I had previously put the figure for Wigan as 6 so the total has increased by nine. The London borough of Redbridge has announced five of its 12 libraries, relocating a sixth. editorial.html:
263 libraries plus 17 mobiles currently under threat or recently closed.

Wigan has put out a public consultation that says only 2 of its 17 libraries are safe from closure. It is unlikely Wigan will close all of these but it is possible so the figure stands as 15 out of 17 under threat. I had previously put the figure for Wigan as 6 so the total has increased by nine. The London borough of Redbridge has announced five of its 12 libraries, relocating a sixth.
